Rittaratākara
(Vṛttaratnākara ?) mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan dated 1442 A. D.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 109.

Rīticintāmaṇi
in 3 chs. a small work treating of the Rīti or the manner of several Kṛṣṇalīlās a. happened a. the Bṛndāvana; also a. abridged form of Ānandavṛndāvanacampū. by Viśvanātha Cakravartin ( C. from end of 17th Cent. to beg. of 18th Cent.). ment. by him in his Gurudevāṣṭaka, C.. X.

Rītinirṇaya
by Suvarṇanābha. q. by Rājaśekhara in Kāvyamīmāṃsa.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL.

Rītivṛttilakṣaṇa
alaṅk. by Viṭṭhala Dīkṣita alias Viṭṭhaleśvara.
